action.objective: Verify c2c4, the reserved broad-search suggestion, at full depth; it gains queenside space and prepares to challenge Be6/Bd7 while keeping the queen active on b5.
action.rationale: Broad search reached only depth 2 (exact +16) with most alternatives bounded. c2c4 is the reserved verification candidate with 2000 nodes; single-candidate verification will search to effective depth 4 and run mate/tactical-refutation probes to establish commit readiness before choosing.
